title: 2027 Public Domain Film Contest: The Internet Archive is Looking For Creative Short Films Made By You!
content:
We invite filmmakers, artists, and creatives of all skill levels and backgrounds to celebrate Public Domain Day, by creating and uploading a short film not exceeding 4 minutes to the Internet Archive.

This contest offers a chance to explore and reimagine the creative treasures entering the public domain, especially works from 1931 that enter the public domain on January 1—classic literature, early sound films, cartoons, music, and art. Participants are encouraged to use materials from the Internet Archive’s collections to craft unique films that breathe new life into these cultural gems.

Top entries will be awarded prizes up to $2,000, with winners announced during our in-person Public Domain Day Celebration on January 27, 2027. All submissions will be featured in a special Public Domain Day Collection on archive.org and highlighted in a January 2027 blog post.

Join us in this creative celebration of cultural heritage and timeless art!
